scope: Behavioral comparison, no production skill edits
writers: Fresh agents without parent conversation; identical tasks; assigned skill and all four substantive references only
review: Two fresh reviewers blinded to condition and replicate; per-case randomized A/B; anchored criteria fixed before writing

ratings.pass: Meets material task criteria; no substantive overcorrection, undercorrection or factual defect
ratings.minor: Useful result with a limited avoidable defect

limitations: Same model family and shared platform/developer instructions; not an isolated model-system-prompt experiment
Two repeats are diagnostic, not statistical reliability estimates
Synthetic cases plus one known Meridian failure; not representative user research
Root authored candidate and rubric; blinded reviewers reduce but do not remove evaluator bias
References preserved except specific conflicting passages; tests assess this particular revision
